1.text: Fun, enjoy it! I've set Saturday's dinner up for the wedding, about 950 kcal, so the buffet is planned rather than a slip. Have breakfast and lunch as planned with some protein in each, so you don't arrive starving. At the buffet, start with a protein dish, fill one plate, and take a short walk after if you can.

The big ones for this week: curd 1.8 kg, onion 1.1 kg, tomato 900 g, paneer 600 g, toned milk 1.4 L and bhindi 500 g, plus toor dal 350 g and roasted chana 300 g. The full list, grouped by aisle with tick boxes, is on the Meals tab under Grocery list for the week.
